state.lastRunNotes: Checked NEAR's rally (Venice AI confidential inference launch Sept 24, new Private Limit Orders, Confidential Intents TVL ~$70M/volume $27B) - genuine continuing catalysts explain the Wikipedia attention spike, not just old news, but price hasn't hit target and cash is already at the 5% floor so no room to add. LTC's Coinbase fixed-rate loan collateral catalyst is confirmed and still driving on-chain volume, already reflected in the held position. Broader market is a healthy altcoin rotation (positive BTC ETF flows, BTC chopping ~$84k) with no fresh idiosyncratic trigger for any watchlist name outside current holdings. No position has hit its 14-day minimum hold plus target, and none hit its stop, so no sells are eligible; with cash at the floor, holding everything unchanged. Growth/core split stays ~60/40, within the 35-65 band.

trades.rationale: US spot BTC ETFs took in $3.52B in August with only 5/21 sessions seeing outflows; over $648M in short positions unwound as price broke above $85k, and BTC is on a rare three-month winning streak. Establishing core position on this institutional-flow catalyst despite today's intraday pullback on rising bond yields.
trades.sentimentSummary: Bullish institutional flow narrative, but short-term choppy as yields rise; mixed but net positive.
